title: L4-L5 mean peak intradiscal pressure (9 needle sensors) under 10 Nm and pelvic obliquity
condition: intact; pure moment and pelvic-obliquity combined loading

quantity.name: IDP absolute
quantity.definition: mean of the peak pressures of all 9 sensors (3 Denton 6376 15-gauge needles x 3 sensors each) in the L4-L5 disc, absolute, mean +- SD, n=8; sensor zone (nucleus/annulus) not confirmed

source.authors: Popovich JM Jr, Welcher JB, Hedman TP, Tawackoli W, Anand N, Chen TC, Kulig K
source.sample: 8 specimens (7 L1-sacrum, 1 L3-sacrum); measurements at L4-L5; 8 fresh-frozen human lumbosacral spines (7 L1-S, 1 L3-S) without gross deformity or major degeneration

protocol.summary: Bose Kinematic Spine Testing Device; specimens potted in polyurethane with L4 superior endplate horizontal; pure moments +-10 Nm at 1 deg/s; 5 preconditioning cycles then 3 recorded cycles, 2nd cycle analysed; no preload. Conditions: flexion/extension, lateral bending, axial rotation, and simulated pelvic obliquity = sacrum tilted left 5 deg or 10 deg (lumbar spine in right lateral bending) followed by +-10 Nm axial rotation.
how_to_simulate: Fix sacrum (cranial end loaded; L1 or L3 free); no preload
Apply pure moment +-10 Nm in FL/EX, LB, AR; for pelvic obliquity tilt the sacrum 5 or 10 deg to the left in the frontal plane, then apply +-10 Nm axial rotation
Report peak disc pressure averaged over a 3x3 array spanning the L4-L5 disc (nucleus and inner annulus); LB = right, AR = left
protocol.notes: IDP: three needle transducers (R.A. Denton 6376, each with 3 sensors along the distal needle) inserted into the L4-L5 disc, placement checked by fluoroscopy only; the reported value is the mean peak of all nine sensors, absolute pressure. No preload, so values are moment-induced pressures on top of the unloaded state.

data.load: sacrum 5 deg left tilt + 10 Nm AR
sacrum 10 deg left tilt + 10 Nm AR

extraction.uncertainty: exact for text values; extension digitised +-3 kPa (0.62 px/kPa at 300 dpi; text-reported bars re-digitised 0.3-1.6 kPa high)
